title: Autonomous ETL Pipelines for Salesforce M&A Consolidation: A Reference Framework, Jitterbit Mapping, and Reproducible Simulation Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.05918v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Merging companies that each run Salesforce must consolidate their customer data into a single organization while both source systems remain in use. This requires reconciling different schemas and picklists, resolving duplicate customers across and within organizations, preserving relationships between records, and keeping the target current until cutover. This article proposes a reference framework for an autonomous extract-transform-load pipeline for this task. It combines partitioned bulk extraction, declarative mapping templates, rule-based and statistical quality gates, master data management with deterministic and blocked fuzzy matching, constrained loading with per-record error capture, and change data capture guarded by a data-health circuit breaker. translated_title: 面向Salesforce并购整合的自主ETL管道：参考框架、Jitterbit映射与可复现仿真研究
translated_abstract: 各自运行Salesforce的合并公司必须在两个源系统仍持续使用的情况下，将客户数据整合到单一组织中。这需要协调不同的数据模式与选项列表、解决组织之间及组织内部的重复客户问题、保留记录之间的关系，并在系统切换前保持目标数据的实时更新。本文针对该任务提出了一种自主式提取-转换-加载（ETL）管道的参考框架，它结合了分区批量提取、声明式映射模板、基于规则与统计的质量门控、采用确定性匹配与分块模糊匹配的主数据管理、具备逐条记录错误捕获的受限加载，以及由数据健康熔断器保护的变化数据捕获（CDC）。框架的每个阶段均映射到Jitterbit Integration Studio的构件。该框架被实现为开放参考原型，并在合成的双组织场景上进行了评估……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一个面向Salesforce并购场景的自主ETL参考框架，通过分区提取、声明式映射、质量门控、确定性及分块模糊匹配的主数据管理、受限加载和熔断器保护的变化数据捕获，解决了双源系统并行期间的数据去重、记录关系保留与持续同步难题，并将全流程映射至Jitterbit Integration Studio构件。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an autonomous ETL reference framework for Salesforce M&A data consolidation, combining partitioned extraction, declarative mapping, quality gates, deterministic/blocked fuzzy matching MDM, constrained loading, and circuit-breaker-guarded change data capture—all mapped to Jitterbit Integration Studio constructs.
